findings.problem: Design labels docs edits as "§6" / numbered sections, but src/app/docs/page.tsx is JSX with comment markers (no numbered sections).
findings.fix: Target the {/* POST /api/v1/messages */} block (~line 459) and {/* GET /api/v1/templates */} block (~line 532) rather than a literal "§6".

findings.problem: buttons is a JSON string whose button type is stored upper-case (e.g. "URL"); dynamic detection must tolerate array/garbage shapes and case.
findings.fix: After parseJsonColumn, guard for non-array/garbage (return false) and match type case-insensitively before testing url.includes("{{").

findings.problem: btnParam and buttonIsDynamic are computed in both the gate and the button-emission site, risking divergence if one is later edited.
findings.fix: Compute buttonIsDynamic and btnParam once and reuse at both sites.
